title: The 2nd Best Stock to Buy Right Now | NVDA Stock vs. Meta Stock
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc ranks the two best stocks to buy right now after digesting Meta's latest results, and puts Nvidia first and Meta second; he owns both, and both sit among his largest positions behind Netflix. Nvidia trades at $213 (stated) against his $345 DCF fair value — about 62% undervalued — on a 13.4x forward P/E, with forward EPS growth expectations near 50%, hyperscaler capital spending passing $850 billion in 2026 and possibly $1.2–1.4 trillion next year, return on invested capital above 100% for over a year, and an asset-light model that outsources manufacturing to TSMC. Meta trades at $646 (stated), about 46% undervalued on his DCF (the exact fair-value figure dropped out of the auto-captions), on an 18.5x forward P/E, with 19% forward EPS growth expectations he wagers will prove low, quarterly revenue up 26% with 12% fewer employees, and the Muse personal agent already past 10 million downloads. The bear case for both is the same: the thesis rests on hyperscaler spending delivering returns, Meta's capex keeps rising with likely equity raises to fund it, and Nvidia's circular investments in customers draw scepticism. Both are BUY reiterations, not flips.
